question: Why is it important to separate the concept of punishment from its justification?

options.A: Because the concept of punishment has evolved over time.
options.B: Because punishment can be justified in multiple ways.
options.C: Because any definition of punishment should be value-neutral.
options.D: Because the practice of punishment is separate from its justification.
options.E: Because the justification of punishment varies across cultures.
options.F: Because the concept of punishment is often misunderstood.
options.G: Because the concept of punishment is controversial.
options.H: Because the justification of punishment is a matter of personal opinion.
options.I: Because its justification depends on the concept employed.
